title: Release the LPM product (maintainers)
description: Use only inside the LPM product repository (lpm) to ship LPM to production (deploy, subir para produção): checks, candidate, golden set, promote, smoke, rollback, deploy evidence (Cloud Run revision, smoke) on the activity, pilot notice. Not for an AISH pacote de release (use lpm-aish-delivery).
doneWhen: The promoted revision serves 100 % of traffic and the smoke passed, or the rollback target serves 100 % again after a failed smoke. Evidence (with the rollback target) is attached to the activity, and pilots were informed only after live verification.
authorityCeiling: Process skill (no owned tools); stops on any failed check; promotion and rollback only through the steps below.
jobs: deploy the fix to production (lpm.rocks) with a candidate revision first
run the golden-set subset on the candidate and compare it with the last report
promote the candidate revision and run the MCP smoke
faz o deploy em produção com CANDIDATE_ONLY e golden set
promover o candidato para 100% do tráfego e rodar o smoke
rollback da revisão do LPM em produção para o rollback target
anexa a revisão do Cloud Run, os testes e o smoke como evidência na atividade
add a golden-set regression for the confirmed pilot failure (fixture or vitest)
